blocks.content: Course: HTML Fundamentals for Your First Webpage
Welcome to our HTML Fundamentals for Your First Webpage course. This is a crash course of sorts that'll quickly teach you only the core essentials needed for an aspiring junior web developer.
As such, this course is minimalistic and to the point; please practice everything you learn diligently and repeatedly to get the most out of it.
Click the Next Lesson button to proceed through the course.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
